speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to my clinic. I see you are experiencing double vision, difficulty climbing stairs, and upper limb weakness; let's start by asking, does your double vision improve when you close one eye?

speaker: Patient
text: The double vision usually happens when I look up or down, and the weakness in my arms and legs gets worse after activity but improves if I rest. I have not noticed balance problems or numbness.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for that description; the worsening with activity and improvement with rest is very telling. Since your double vision worsens when looking up or down, I need to know if you experience any drooping of your eyelids or difficulty swallowing as well.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis
